title: Direct-response ad video editor
description:
Empresa está contratando Direct-response ad video editor em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding. You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day. Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts. This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline. What You'll Be Doing Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3 D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build Velor Health versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated Tik Tok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates What You Need Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or Tik Tok with measurable results) Fluency in Cap Cut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person) Bonus (Not Required) Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation) What You Don't Need A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you. Compensation Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work. How To Apply There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works: Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or Tik Tok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired. We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time? If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output. We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut. To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

title: Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese )
description:
Nova oportunidade para Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese ) em palmas. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Company Description: Million Logics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, Million Logics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results. Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Offer Details: Duration of Contract: 6 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese ) Skills: Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Key Qualifications: Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese ) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience: BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Additional Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 6 months

Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe. Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção. Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput. Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas. Design e Arquitetura Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios. Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos. Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos. Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas. Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados. Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais. Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas. Infraestrutura e Deploy Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações Web Logic. Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (Git Lab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment. Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes. Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA. Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas. Colaboração e Crescimento Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade. Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento. Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos. Requisitos Obrigatórios: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java. Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes). Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design Go F (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema. Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento. Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras. Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte. Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual. Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD. Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/Open API para desenvolvimento de APIs. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta. Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR. Requisitos Desejáveis: Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning. Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS. Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing. Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs. title: Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd
description:
Empresa está contratando Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a Service Now Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress. EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices; Profile: Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA); Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

title: Data engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Data engineer em manaus. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Company Description First Ignite develops AI-powered tools designed to support universities in key areas such as Tech Transfer, Corporate Relations, Advancement, Career Development, and Research Development. These tools empower universities to expand their initiatives and streamline operations effectively. First Ignite is dedicated to helping academic institutions grow and thrive through innovative technological solutions, making a meaningful impact in the education sector. Role Description This is a full-time remote role for a Data Engineer. The Data Engineer, will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems focused on acquiring, structuring, and integrating diverse datasets from external and internal sources. This role will be responsible for building reliable data acquisition pipelines, including crawling, scraping, API ingestion, data mining, enrichment, and ETL workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into accurate, usable data for First Ignite's platform. Qualifications Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources. Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (Py Spark), Lambda, S3, and RDS Postgre SQL. Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed. Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale. Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems. Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation. Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities. Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team. Requirements Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines. Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/Py Spark, Lambda, S3, RDS Postgre SQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks. Strong experience with external data acquisition, including building and maintaining crawlers, scrapers, API integrations, and data mining workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into reliable, structured datasets. This includes handling rate limits, source changes, deduplication, validation, enrichment, and pipeline monitoring. Familiarity with RESTful and Graph QL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies. Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications. Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods. Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in Saa S or tech environments. Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices. Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar). LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output. Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines. As part of your Linked In application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you're proud of. Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

This role will be responsible for building reliable data acquisition pipelines, including crawling, scraping, API ingestion, data mining, enrichment, and ETL workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into accurate, usable data for First Ignite's platform. Qualifications Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources. Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (Py Spark), Lambda, S3, and RDS Postgre SQL. Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed. Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale. Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems. Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation. Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities. Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team. Requirements Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines. Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/Py Spark, Lambda, S3, RDS Postgre SQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks. Familiarity with RESTful and Graph QL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies. Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications. Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods. Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in Saa S or tech environments. Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices. Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar). LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output. Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines. title: Direct-response ad video editor
description:
Confira a vaga para Direct-response ad video editor em palmas. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding. You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day. Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts. This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline. What You'll Be Doing Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3 D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build Velor Health versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated Tik Tok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates What You Need Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or Tik Tok with measurable results) Fluency in Cap Cut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person) Bonus (Not Required) Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation) What You Don't Need A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you. Compensation Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work. How To Apply There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works: Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or Tik Tok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired. We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time? If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output. We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — Our history & global footprint — LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial Io T, connected payments, and more. Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R&D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market. "Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay." What You'll Do Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions. Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I²C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For Experience designing PCBA end-to-end. Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G) and Wi-Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Prior ANATEL homologation experience. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5 G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Apply via: sasha.saini@ | Browse open roles: Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — Our history & global footprint — LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role Smart modules are where Quectel's cellular tech meets serious compute — Android and Linux platforms with camera, multimedia, and AI capabilities, powering everything from smart POS terminals to AI vision devices and connected industrial equipment. This is a founding-team role at Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll own the smart-module software story for the LATAM region: drivers, peripheral bring-up, multimedia and camera frameworks, and the customer-facing engineering work that turns Quectel modules into shipping products. Because the team is being built from scratch, you'll help define the technical playbook, the customer engagement model, and the way smart-module work happens here. "Smart modules let you touch the whole stack — kernel drivers, camera HAL, all the way up to Android apps. Doing that as part of a founding team, where you shape how things get built? Even better." What You'll Do Own software development and maintenance for assigned LATAM customer projects on Quectel smart modules. Design and develop camera algorithms — image processing, enhancement, optimization. Bring up and integrate camera and image processing features into customer applications. Run camera testing and tuning across lighting conditions to deliver great image quality. Debug peripheral bring-up issues: MIPI LCD, sensors, MIPI camera, audio/video codecs. Support LATAM customers: develop new SW features, debug their issues, improve the SW stack and demo applications. Collaborate with overseas R&D teams — platform, hardware, FAEs, project managers, QA. Document what you build: design specs, technical analysis reports, knowledge articles. Write clean, scalable, efficient code — and improve the code that's already there. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 3–5 years of embedded software experience on Android and/or Linux platforms. Strong C, C++, and Java programming skills. Solid Linux internals and system programming knowledge; RTOS exposure is a plus. Experience with the embedded software development lifecycle. Hands-on experience with Android applications, HAL, and multimedia frameworks (GStreamer, Cam X, Open CV, Open GL). Linux device driver development and peripheral bring-up experience (MIPI LCD, sensors, MIPI camera, audio/video codecs). Comfort with hardware/software integration and debugging. Day-to-day experience with Git and Agile workflows. Strong problem-solving skills and customer-friendly communication. Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For AI / machine learning experience for image analysis. Familiarity with Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X / Chi-CDK). Prior FAE or customer-engineering experience in the LATAM region. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's smart module portfolio — Android, Linux, and Yocto-based platforms supporting cameras, displays, audio, GNSS, Wi-Fi/BT, and 5 G. Read the deep-dive: "What is a smart module? " by a Quectel product manager. Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X/Chi-CDK), GStreamer, Open CV, Open GL, and AI/ML at the edge. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. description:

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a Service Now Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress. EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices; Profile: Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA); Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

This is a founding-team role at Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll own the smart-module software story for the LATAM region: drivers, peripheral bring-up, multimedia and camera frameworks, and the customer-facing engineering work that turns Quectel modules into shipping products. Because the team is being built from scratch, you'll help define the technical playbook, the customer engagement model, and the way smart-module work happens here. "Smart modules let you touch the whole stack — kernel drivers, camera HAL, all the way up to Android apps. Doing that as part of a founding team, where you shape how things get built? Even better." What You'll Do Own software development and maintenance for assigned LATAM customer projects on Quectel smart modules. Design and develop camera algorithms — image processing, enhancement, optimization. Bring up and integrate camera and image processing features into customer applications. Run camera testing and tuning across lighting conditions to deliver great image quality. Debug peripheral bring-up issues: MIPI LCD, sensors, MIPI camera, audio/video codecs. Support LATAM customers: develop new SW features, debug their issues, improve the SW stack and demo applications. Collaborate with overseas R& D teams — platform, hardware, FAEs, project managers, QA. Document what you build: design specs, technical analysis reports, knowledge articles. Write clean, scalable, efficient code — and improve the code that's already there. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 3–5 years of embedded software experience on Android and/or Linux platforms. Strong C, C++, and Java programming skills. Solid Linux internals and system programming knowledge; RTOS exposure is a plus. Experience with the embedded software development lifecycle. Hands-on experience with Android applications, HAL, and multimedia frameworks (GStreamer, Cam X, Open CV, Open GL). Linux device driver development and peripheral bring-up experience (MIPI LCD, sensors, MIPI camera, audio/video codecs). Comfort with hardware/software integration and debugging. Day-to-day experience with Git and Agile workflows. Strong problem-solving skills and customer-friendly communication. Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For AI / machine learning experience for image analysis. Familiarity with Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X / Chi-CDK). Prior FAE or customer-engineering experience in the LATAM region. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's smart module portfolio — Android, Linux, and Yocto-based platforms supporting cameras, displays, audio, GNSS, Wi-Fi/BT, and 5 G. Read the deep-dive: "What is a smart module?" by a Quectel product manager. Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X/Chi-CDK), GStreamer, Open CV, Open GL, and AI/ML at the edge. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R& D — work side-by-side with our R& D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. title: Software engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Software engineer em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Software Engineer-SMART MODULE Founding smart-module engineer at Quectel's new Manaus hub Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil Role Software Engineer – Smart Module – LATAM Level Mid-Level (3–5 years of experience) Type Full-Time, On-Site Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus About Quectel Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular Io T modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — Our history & global footprint — LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role Smart modules are where Quectel's cellular tech meets serious compute — Android and Linux platforms with camera, multimedia, and AI capabilities, powering everything from smart POS terminals to AI vision devices and connected industrial equipment. This is a founding-team role at Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll own the smart-module software story for the LATAM region: drivers, peripheral bring-up, multimedia and camera frameworks, and the customer-facing engineering work that turns Quectel modules into shipping products. Because the team is being built from scratch, you'll help define the technical playbook, the customer engagement model, and the way smart-module work happens here. "Smart modules let you touch the whole stack — kernel drivers, camera HAL, all the way up to Android apps. Doing that as part of a founding team, where you shape how things get built? Even better." What You'll Do Own software development and maintenance for assigned LATAM customer projects on Quectel smart modules. Design and develop camera algorithms — image processing, enhancement, optimization. Bring up and integrate camera and image processing features into customer applications. Run camera testing and tuning across lighting conditions to deliver great image quality. Debug peripheral bring-up issues: MIPI LCD, sensors, MIPI camera, audio/video codecs. Support LATAM customers: develop new SW features, debug their issues, improve the SW stack and demo applications. Collaborate with overseas R&D teams — platform, hardware, FAEs, project managers, QA. Document what you build: design specs, technical analysis reports, knowledge articles. Write clean, scalable, efficient code — and improve the code that's already there. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 3–5 years of embedded software experience on Android and/or Linux platforms. Strong C, C++, and Java programming skills. Solid Linux internals and system programming knowledge; RTOS exposure is a plus. Experience with the embedded software development lifecycle. Hands-on experience with Android applications, HAL, and multimedia frameworks (GStreamer, Cam X, Open CV, Open GL). Linux device driver development and peripheral bring-up experience (MIPI LCD, sensors, MIPI camera, audio/video codecs). Comfort with hardware/software integration and debugging. Day-to-day experience with Git and Agile workflows. Strong problem-solving skills and customer-friendly communication. Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For AI / machine learning experience for image analysis. Familiarity with Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X / Chi-CDK). Prior FAE or customer-engineering experience in the LATAM region. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's smart module portfolio — Android, Linux, and Yocto-based platforms supporting cameras, displays, audio, GNSS, Wi-Fi/BT, and 5 G. Read the deep-dive: "What is a smart module?" by a Quectel product manager. Qualcomm camera frameworks (Cam X/Chi-CDK), GStreamer, Open CV, Open GL, and AI/ML at the edge. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2 B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15 M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2 E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. Postgre SQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. Type Script primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, Hub Spot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or Web Sockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product Saa S background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent Postgre SQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty. What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15 M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you. To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.
